name: Reset password
description: The caller cannot sign in and wants the password reset, with the reset sent to their phone.

gate.question: Is this a password-reset call: does the caller want their online banking password reset?

fields.model_hint: The phone number the caller gives for the reset.

steps.name: Greet and open
steps.description: State the bank name and your own name, then ask how you can help.
steps.example_phrase: Hello, this is Harper Valley National Bank, my name is Jennifer. How can I help you today?
steps.done_when: The agent names the bank and gives their own name, then asks how they can help.

steps.name: Collect phone number
steps.description: Get the phone number for the reset, by asking or by confirming.
steps.example_phrase: What phone number should I send the reset to?
steps.done_when: The agent has the phone number from the caller: asked for it, or confirmed it after the caller gave it.

steps.name: Log the password reset
steps.description: Log the task type and the phone number.

sub_checks.description: The agent logged the task type 'reset password'
The logged phone number matches what the caller said

steps.done_when: The agent logged the right task type and values.

steps.name: Offer further help
steps.description: Ask whether the caller needs anything else.
steps.example_phrase: Is there anything else I can help you with?
steps.done_when: The agent asks whether the caller needs anything else.

steps.name: Close
steps.description: Thank the caller and end the call.
steps.example_phrase: Thank you for calling, you have a great day.
steps.done_when: The agent thanks the caller or says goodbye before the call ends.
